steps.action: Open the instance address on a fresh instance
steps.expected: Set up OpenLaw shows Setup token, Name, Email, Password, Confirm password and Create Administrator.
steps.actual: Setup token label read "Setup token*". needsSetup was true; / redirected to /auth/setup, which showed Set up OpenLaw with Setup token, Name, Email, Password, Confirm password and Create Administrator.

steps.action: Open OpenLaw from another address (localhost instead of the instance address 127.0.0.1) and submit the setup form
steps.expected: OpenLaw refuses to save and shows "This request did not come from this OpenLaw instance's own origin."
steps.actual: At http://localhost:43301/auth/setup, Create Administrator showed "This request did not come from this OpenLaw instance's own origin." and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Submit the setup form with the Setup token left empty
steps.expected: Setup does not continue and no account is created.
steps.actual: The browser blocked the submit: the Setup token field reported a missing value ("Please fill out this field."). The page did not show the token message; alerts "". The page stayed on /auth/setup and needsSetup stayed true.
steps.guideFinding: The guide (Create the first Administrator, step 3) says a missing or wrong token shows the token message. With the field empty, the browser's required-field check shows "Please fill out this field." instead and nothing is sent. Run 11 (firstrun3 C1) records this as a failed step against the guide's own wording.

steps.action: Submit the setup form with a wrong Setup token
steps.expected: The page shows "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from SETUP_TOKEN." and no account is created.
steps.actual: The page showed "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from SETUP_TOKEN.", stayed on /auth/setup, and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Submit a seven-character password in both fields with the correct token
steps.expected: The password is refused and setup does not continue.
steps.actual: The Password field reported a too-short value, the page stayed on /auth/setup, and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Submit different values in Password and Confirm password
steps.expected: The page shows "The passwords do not match." and no account is created.
steps.actual: The page showed "The passwords do not match.", stayed on /auth/setup, and needsSetup stayed true.
